Core scaffold complete. Files created:

**Project init:**
- package.json, tsconfig.json, Dockerfile, .env.example

**Core modules:**
- `src/types.ts` — shared types
- `src/gateway.ts` — WebSocket gateway (in-memory subscription router)
- `src/webhook.ts` — Telegram webhook handler (Telegraf)
- `src/admin.ts` — Admin API (bot register/unregister/list)

**Hono app wiring:**
- `src/app.ts` — Hono routes (webhook + admin endpoints)
- `src/index.ts` — server bootstrap (HTTP + WS)

**Client SDK:**
- `client-sdk/telegram-gateway-client/index.ts` — TS client with auto-reconnect

Build passes clean (`npm run build`). Dev server starts on port 3000.
